description: This file defines a data source class for an Angular application that manages a virtual scrolling grid, including data fetching, dynamic column adjustment, and grid cell management.

classes.name: ScrollGridDatasource
classes.description: A data source class for managing grid data with virtual scrolling, dynamic columns, and server-side data fetching.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the data source to a collection viewer and sets up data fetching and viewport observation.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the data source, unsubscribing from all subscriptions and resetting state.

methods.name: updateFilter
methods.description: Updates the filter used for data fetching and refreshes the data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Refreshes the data grid, recalculating ranges and fetching data as needed.

methods.name: updateItem
methods.description: Updates a specific item in the data array and refreshes the grid.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes an item at a specified index and updates the grid accordingly.
